label.purpose: Field labels, actions, statuses, authors, and system text.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Background, border, and active-position feedback; reduced to 0.01ms when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The full-width action that creates a room.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font: 800 12px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #94d5ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; background: #24479d; color: #dce4ff; }

components.name: Compact Action
components.description: The intrinsic-width companion action used for Enter and Send.
components.css: .ds-btn-compact { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 19px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font: 800 12px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-compact:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-compact:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #94d5ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-compact:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-compact:disabled { cursor: wait; background: #24479d; color: #dce4ff; }

components.name: Underlined Field
components.description: The transparent field used for display names and messages.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">Display name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" placeholder="How others will see you">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 6px; color: #dce4ff; font: 800 12px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #24356f; border-radius: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: #f7f8ff; font: 500 15px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8c9bc9; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #3653b3; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #94d5ff; }

components.name: Room Code Field
components.description: The underlined room field with shareable code treatment.
components.css: .ds-code-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #24356f; border-radius: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: #f7f8ff; font: 500 15px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-code-input:hover { border-color: #3653b3; } .ds-code-input:focus { border-color: #94d5ff; }

components.name: Entry Divider
components.description: A ruled text divider separating create and enter paths without a container.
components.css: .ds-divider { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 14px; color: #aebce8; font: 800 12px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-divider::before, .ds-divider::after { height: 1px; background: #24356f; content: ""; }

components.name: Message Row
components.description: A participant message expressed as a hairline-separated row, never a bubble.
components.css: .ds-message { margin: 0; padding: 13px 2px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #24356f; color: #f7f8ff; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 500 15px/1.5 "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-message strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; color: #66c2ff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Connection Recovery
components.description: Plain recovery copy shown after connection loss; it is never a badge or panel.
components.html: Connection lost. Refresh the page to rejoin.
components.css: .ds-recovery { margin: 12px 0 0; color: #ff9caf; font: 700 12px/1.45 "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
OrbChat is a free-standing room utility, not a branded destination or miniature app shell. Room entry and conversation sit directly on a solid deep-navy page; open spacing and hairline rules provide all necessary structure. The interface should feel immediate, quiet, and native to Orb Games without importing its site chrome.

The system is code-first and deliberately reduced. Nunito keeps the utility approachable, accessible solid blue actions establish the path forward, and every visible element serves the short story: name yourself, create or enter a room, then exchange temporary messages.
keyCharacteristics: One free-standing control column, capped at 500px.
Solid deep-navy canvas with no gradients, cards, or ornamental containers.
Accessible solid blue actions and bright-blue informational emphasis.
Transparent underlined fields and hairline conversation structure.
No visible logo, heading, connection badge, or repeated status decoration.

rules.name: The One Canvas Rule
rules.body: Keep the page and utility on Continuous Navy; never introduce a second surface to imply a card, well, header, or nested shell.

rules.name: The Action Contrast Rule
rules.body: Enabled actions use Action Blue and hover to Pressed Blue; Signal Sky is informational, not an alternate button color.

rules.name: The No Headline Rule
rules.body: The first viewport begins with the display-name field; do not add a title, logo, wordmark, tagline, or introductory copy above it.

rules.name: The Code Clarity Rule
rules.body: Room codes remain uppercase, tabular, and widely tracked so they can be read and shared without ambiguity.

rules.name: The Hairlines-Only Rule
rules.body: When separation is required, use open space or a one-pixel line; never solve hierarchy with a card, background patch, or shadow.

rules.name: The Enclosure Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: A filled rounded shape means “action.” Do not reuse it for identity, status, messages, sections, or decoration.

dos: Do keep entry and conversation directly on Continuous Navy in one 500px column.
Do use Action Blue and Pressed Blue for enabled action states with explicit Focus Sky keyboard outlines.
Do use spacing and one-pixel lines to organize fields, dividers, messages, and the conversation viewport.
Do keep connection recovery visible as plain text and disable the entire composer when disconnected.
Do preserve readable mobile padding, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add a logo, wordmark, title, branded header, intro copy, or navigation chrome.
Don't add a gradient, outer card, boxed message well, message bubbles, raised surface, or shadow.
Don't add Ready, Connected, Connecting, or Disconnected badges; routine state stays visually silent.
Don't use ornamental containers, repeated status decoration, or shipping raster artwork.
Don't introduce a second font, decorative display type, or a competing accent hue.
